**Advisory — coordinator teardown proof (44), read-only**

Grounding: `verify-native-coordinator-44.mjs` gives real SDK attribution (per-call `tool_execution_start/end`, callId hash) but its coordinator session runs in-process with the verifier, so no process ever dies. `verify-pi-worker-44-teardown.mjs` proves initiating-Pi ESRCH before gate release plus worker survival, but with no actual SDK coordinator. `worker-lifecycle.mjs` spawns the worker `detached:true` + `unref`, and `read|reconcile` only call `observe()` — survival and no-autorelaunch are already structural.

**A — native child SDK + IPC barrier.** Parent node spawns one child running the actual SDK session (Luna High whole override, only `coordinator_cli`). Child forwards JSON-lines on stdio: launch `tool_execution_start/end`, callIdSha256, launch ack. Parent SIGKILLs that child pid only after launch end and asserts ESRCH via `kill(pid,0)`. Worker hold polls coordinator death/release gate, ≤10 s, fail-closed. Fresh process then `read`/`reconcile` to terminal. Real attribution; moderate wrapper code.

**B — no-new-model deterministic control.** Same wrapper, stub child runs fixed prepare/launch through the offline bridge; zero provider calls. Proves lifecycle mechanics (detached worker, store handoff, ESRCH, resume) but not real SDK teardown or model authorship. Cheap, deterministic.

**Recommendation (minimum): B as the SHA-pinned offline precall gate, then A as the single authorized real run.** One wrapper, no production resolver/dispatcher: extract the bridge/SDK code from the existing verifier, reuse the teardown gate pattern, shared exports, two evidence JSONs. Keep origTaskSha256 and gatedTaskSha256 distinct; `prepared.taskSha256` binds the gated file actually launched; never claim it matches the unwrapped original. Exactly one coordinator + one canonical worker, no observer model, retry, or fallback; parent kills its own child only. Budgets: gate wait ≤10 s, worker 120 s, coordinator 180 s. Scope stays narrow: coordinator-child death → detached worker+store survive → fresh CLI observes/reconciles terminal. Not main-chat teardown, crash robustness, all-child death, restart, or daemon. Evidence carries hashes only; no auth values or raw logs.
